assembly_notes: Five independent structural slots over one grounded carcass part. carcass_form owns the load-bearing case family and exports the front-aperture interface (front plane y, aperture half-width and centre, an upper band and a lower band in z) plus the per-row shelf bays. front_treatment consumes only that aperture, so all 8x6x2x3x3 = 864 combinations build without a compatibility gate: the barrister exports its section stack, the corner its right wing, the ladder its vertical base box, grid_hutch/cube_grid their widest cell, two_tier_hutch its tier split and legged_highboy its lifted floor. Every revolute door and flip-up flap is solved by mate_axes on the real hinge line and registered with register_interface_mate; adjustable shelves are placed by mate_planes against the declared shelf-bay extent. Support paths are real geometry rather than allowances: door barrels are captured 3 mm inside their carcass hinge leaves, drawer sides 2 mm inside their runners, and adjustable shelf ends 2 mm inside their pilaster standards over the whole travel. width_m, depth_m, height_m and shelf_thickness_m are honest continuous parameters and do not inflate core/raw; height_m is derived upward when shelf_count would otherwise crush the bays below 0.135 m of clear height.

derived.expression: 0.002 constant engagement over 2*shelf_travel_m + shelf_thickness_m + 0.060 of standard
derived.name: pilaster_engage_m
derived.rationale: the moving shelf keeps a real support path at every pose
